items.a: A lien on real property or a pledge on a business share. We also accept a pledge on the company's movable assets.

items.q: What is the maximum loan amount?
items.a: Up to €2,000,000 for real estate projects and up to €1,000,000 for business loans.

items.q: How quickly can I receive funding?
items.a: We decide within 5 business days. Disbursement within 2 weeks of approval.
From 10% to 18% p.a. depending on the project type and quality of collateral.

items.q: Can I repay the loan early?
items.a: Yes, at any time without penalties. Interest is only charged on the actual drawdown period.
No, we exclusively finance legal entities — LLCs and joint-stock companies.
